jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Representative (English + East EU language)
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. You work hand in hand with the External Sales Representative and help strengthen customer relationships, drive sales growth, and promote the use of our digital tools. 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Open new customer accounts (approx. 30%) and grow business with existing customers (approx. 70%) 

• Prepare accurate offers and price calculations 

• Enter and follow up on orders 

• Actively manage your accounts via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digital migration 

• Maintain and update customer data in the internal system 

• Understand customer needs, market context, product applications, and competitors 

• Be the main point of contact for customer inquiries, complaints, and support 

• Identify and close commercial opportunities 

• Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - no experience required!
jobs.description:
Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

At Agristo, you are the key player in the packaging process: from frozen fries to a perfectly packaged and palletized product. With your technical affinity and problem-solving abilities, you manage our packaging lines, coordinate the planning, and ensure a flawless process. Are you looking for a challenging role with responsibility, teamwork, and growth opportunities in a dynamic work environment? Join us and grow with a strong, ambitious family business!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
 
• Process Management: You are responsible for the entire packaging process, from frozen fries to a fully palletized and packaged product. 
• Operation and Adjustment: You provide first-line support for any issues on the line, make adjustments when necessary, and continuously expand your technical knowledge of our processes. 
• Planning & Coordination: You monitor and adjust the packaging schedule, coordinating its execution with the team leader to meet the planned goals. 
• Cleanliness and Hygiene: You ensure a clean and organized work environment by overseeing and coordinating cleaning tasks. 
• Material Management: You are responsible for the timely ordering and availability of necessary materials, such as film, cardboard, and spices. 
• Problem Solving: You proactively identify issues in the packaging process and take corrective actions to ensure continuity. 
• Administrative Support: You perform administrative tasks, such as reporting incidents and documenting process information. 
• Packaging Testing: You assist in and conduct packaging process tests in collaboration with Agristo colleagues. 
• Knowledge Sharing: You contribute to the development of instructions and training materials and support knowledge transfer within the team. 
• Employee Guidance: You mentor and support team members, helping them enhance their skills and knowledge.
With this diverse range of responsibilities, you are an essential link in ensuring a smooth and high-quality packaging process!
 
• You have solid experience as a packaging operator in the food industry or have already gained experience in a coordinating role. 
• You possess technical and process insight. 
• You have a problem-solving mindset, are not afraid to critically assess existing processes, and take initiative to implement improvements. 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English and are willing to communicate with colleagues who speak different languages.

• You handle goods safely and efficiently using a forklift truck and electric pallet truck. 
• You work closely with your colleagues to keep the logistics flow running smoothly.

• You have experience with an electric pallet truck and forklift and hold the required certificates. 
• You work in an organised, accurate and punctual manner. 
• You are a team player who enjoys achieving results together with colleagues. 
• You always comply with safety and quality standards. 
• You have initial experience with transport documentation or are motivated to learn. 
• You can communicate confidently in Dutch, French or English. 
• You are comfortable working with computer applications and quickly learn new systems.

Our client is an EU organization based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!
 

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.
 

 
 

Position overview:
 

 
 

An Electrical & Auxillary Supervisor is responsible for leading a team of electrical and maintenance shop team members, managing the life cycle of all support equipment and electrical resources, including execution of maintenance, process improvement and contracting with outside services. This role ensures the reliable and efficient operation of all electrical systems and support equipment within the plant. This role leads a team of electricians and maintenance specialists that focuses on maximizing production throughput, minimizing downtime, and sustaining high equipment availability by leading maintenance activities, troubleshooting electrical and mechanical issues, and implementing proactive improvement strategies. The supervisor drives operational excellence while ensuring safety, compliance, and optimal resource utilization across the plant.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Maintain all electrical systems and auxiliary equipment to ensure high uptime, production throughput, and minimal downtime 

• Lead, coach, and develop electricians and maintenance specialists, ensuring a skilled, high-performing team 

• Plan, prioritize, and oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities 

• Ensure all work is performed safely and in compliance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and food safety standards 

• Identify and implement initiatives to improve equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and cost-effectiveness 

• Rapidly diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical problems to minimize production interruptions 

• Manage personnel, tools, materials, and external contractors effectively to meet operational goals 

• Maintain accurate maintenance logs, equipment records, SOPs, and performance metrics 

• Drive continuous improvement, ensuring optimal utilization of resources and alignment with plant objectives 

What are we looking for?
 

 
 
 

• Technical knowledge of industrial electrical systems, support equipment, conveyance systems 

• Job related experience in an industrial environment with the focus on electrical, mechanical or maintenance role 

• Working knowledge of automation & controls 

• Ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex electrical and mechanical issues 

• Strong knowledge of plant electrical systems, auxiliary equipment, controls, and associated mechanical systems 

• Problem solving, trouble shooting and process improvement skills 

• Project management support for plant capital improvements, line speed alterations, conveyance changes and safety iniatives 

• Comfortable communication in written and spoken English 

• Leads, coaches, and develops a high-performing maintenance and electrical team  

 
 

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation. When you join Ball you belong to a team of over 16,000 members worldwide. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminium cans, cups to aerosol bottles solutions that enable our customers to contribute to a better world.
 

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.
